IONTradeConsideration.title: IONTradeConsideration
IONTradeConsideration.description: ION trade consideration attributes. Inherits directly from RetailConsideration v2.1 and refines inherited breakup taxDetail objects with the shared IONTaxDetail schema.

breakup.description: Inherited RetailConsideration price breakup, refined so each taxDetail object may carry IONTaxDetail classification and compliance fields.

buyerFinderFee.description: The buyer finder fee the seller (BPP) pays the buyer app (BAP) for orders of an offer, deducted from the seller's payout. Not a charge to the buyer, and not part of breakup or totalAmount. On an offer's consideration: the fee terms (feeType, feeValue, appliesTo). On the contract's price consideration in force: feeAmount, the order's total (see IONBuyerFinderFee).

deliveryFee.description: On an offer's consideration: the charge per order for the seller's own delivery of the offer's items (see IONDeliveryFee). The contract states the charge as a DELIVERY_CHARGE breakup line, not with this field.

IONDeliveryFee.title: IONDeliveryFee
IONDeliveryFee.description:
The charge the buyer pays for the seller's own delivery, stated on an offer's consideration. One charge per order: when an order's performanceMode is DELIVERY, the BPP charges the highest deliveryFee amount among the offers ordered, once, as a breakup line of type DELIVERY_CHARGE on the contract's price consideration, included in totalAmount. No charge for SELF_PICKUP, and none when no offer ordered states a deliveryFee.
The line stays while any item is still ordered, through partial cancellations and returns, and is refunded once none is. It is not part of the buyer finder fee base (IONBuyerFinderFee).

amount.description: The delivery charge per order in the consideration currency, including any tax. 0 states free delivery.

IONBuyerFinderFee.title: IONBuyerFinderFee
IONBuyerFinderFee.description:
The buyer finder fee: what the seller (BPP) pays the buyer app (BAP) for orders of an offer, deducted from the seller's payout at settlement. Not a charge to the buyer, and not part of breakup or totalAmount.
On an offer's consideration the seller states the fee terms: feeType, feeValue, and for PERCENT appliesTo. One fee per offer.
On the contract's price consideration in force the BPP states feeAmount, the order's total: the sum, over every offer still ordered, of its fee on its own items -- PERCENT of the unit price (ITEM_TOTAL) or of the unit total with tax (ORDER_TOTAL), or the AMOUNT per unit, times the quantity still ordered. The BPP sets it in on_select and on_init and recomputes it in on_cancel and on_update after cancellations and returns. At reconciliation the settlement's commission.value (IONSettlementReconciliation) equals feeAmount.

feeType.description: PERCENT applies feeValue as a percentage of the appliesTo base of the offer's item value. AMOUNT is a fixed amount per unit sold, in the consideration currency.

feeValue.description: Percentage (0-100) when feeType is PERCENT; amount per unit sold in the consideration currency when feeType is AMOUNT.

appliesTo.description: Base for a PERCENT fee. ITEM_TOTAL is the item value excluding tax, delivery and packing; ORDER_TOTAL includes tax. Only for feeType PERCENT.

feeAmount.description: On the contract's price consideration: the order's total buyer finder fee in the consideration currency, the sum over every offer still ordered. Equals the settlement's commission.value at reconciliation.
